description.value: Sproat Lake Landing is a lakeside resort hotel on Sproat Lake, positioned along the popular Port Alberni to Tofino corridor on Vancouver Island. The property features multiple lake-view room types, Drinkwaters Lounge, Della's Coffee Shop & Grocery, and two onsite saunas operated by Triple Peak Sauna Co. The resort markets itself as the best stop on the way to Tofino, making it a natural rest point for cyclists traversing this route.
